# AWS

This app uses the caller's own AWS access keys for regional STS identity checks and S3 bucket listing. The user account slot accepts multiple AWS connections. Each tool call is bound to one connected account.

The app uses aws4fetch 1.0.20 for AWS Signature Version 4. It uses credential connections only and has no OAuth or one-click sign-in flow. Credentials are read by the server-side app only to sign requests. Access key ID, secret access key, and optional session token are raw secret fields. Region is a plain field shown in the connection form. Tool outputs and error messages omit credential values.

## Connection fields

Each connection needs an access key ID, secret access key, and commercial AWS region. Temporary credentials can also include a session token. The region must match one of the supported values in src/regions.ts. GovCloud, China, and other AWS partitions are not supported.

The provider declares exact regional STS and S3 hostnames for the supported region list. Requests are built from those two service names and a validated region. There is no tool that accepts a URL or makes arbitrary requests.

## Tools

- getCallerIdentity sends STS GetCallerIdentity and returns account ID, ARN, and user ID. The tools service also runs it as the account health check.
- listBuckets returns general-purpose S3 bucket names and creation dates in the connection's configured region. It requests at most 1,000 buckets per call and returns a continuation token when another page exists.

ListBuckets does not return bucket objects, ACLs, policies, or metadata beyond names and creation dates. It does not support directory buckets.

## Required permissions

STS GetCallerIdentity does not require an IAM permission. The principal must have working AWS credentials for the configured commercial region.

To call listBuckets, grant the principal the S3 action s3:ListAllMyBuckets on Resource "*". A minimal read policy is:

    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
          "Resource": "*"
        }
      ]
    }


## References

- [STS GetCallerIdentity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_GetCallerIdentity.html)
- [S3 ListBuckets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListBuckets.html)
- [aws4fetch](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aws4fetch)
